bullets.text: Activists and residents in Chennai and Nemmeli are protesting the proposed reservoir project threatening the Nemmeli coastal wetland, echoing recent outrage over Pallikaranai.
Traders staged a road roko in Gummidipoondi on GNT Road after authorities demolished encroached shops, leading to local traffic disruption.
A woman named Muniyammal was killed in Gummidipoondi when a motorbike struck her while she was crossing the road.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay will share the stage with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Chennai on October 11.
The Greater Chennai Corporation has launched an integrated command and control upgrade plan to modernize infrastructure and tackle urban flooding in Chennai.
Rane Madras has successfully completed the sale of a 3.48-acre land parcel in Velachery to Canopy Living LLP for Rs 361.18 crore, boosting its liquidity.
Feli’s Kitchen has opened in Velachery, introducing traditional Mizo cuisine and Northeastern culinary flavors to local diners in Chennai.
Fisherfolk from Tiruvallur to Chengalpattu continue to protest against the government order regarding the new Secretariat proposal, pinning hopes on Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay.
A minor fire accident occurred near the lamp-lighting area at the Tiruttani Murugan Temple, drawing prompt attention from temple authorities.
The IMD forecasts below-normal northeast monsoon rainfall for northern districts including Tiruvallur, which houses crucial drinking-water reservoirs for Chennai.
The Tamil Nadu Technology Hub has launched an AI-Focused Pre-Incubation Program to support innovators and startups building artificial intelligence solutions.
TIDCO has invited bids for a techno-economic feasibility study to establish a Rs 400-crore fintech hub in Coimbatore, advancing the state's digital infrastructure.
Nine Tamil Nadu students have developed AI applications to solve everyday problems such as worker training via WhatsApp and real-time pothole warnings.
Actor Jai expressed confidence in the TVK government during his media interaction at the Coimbatore airport, predicting victory in the Vikravandi by-election.
